# sevalla_api_key_permissions (Data Source)

Use this data source to list all available Sevalla API key permissions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes List) The list of available API key permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The action this permission allows (CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of what this permission allows.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the permission.
- `name` (String) The name of the permission (e.g., app:read).
- `resource` (String) The resource type this permission applies to (e.g., APP, DATABASE, PIPELINE).
